GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat back rail 7l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat

Best away. Eased early & raced keenly Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until pushed out 3 Wide @ 500m & pushed along Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 250m. Hit lead @ 200m & raced away to win easily. # Far too good.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 Lengths 800m 4th 3 Lengths home turn held up 5th took run 350m Kept Going Ok Straight # honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages. Steadied after improving onto heels rounding the home turn. Was inclined to lay out under pressure down the straight. Jockey cautioned for failing to ride mount out fully over final 2 strides.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped best and Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence trailing the lead, held together much same to turn Held Up rounding turn, narrow rails run presented on straightening, shifted in into the gap and came on properly as cutaway took effect, loomed halfway down the running before the leader/winner got away over the final 75m or So # battled on ok

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground down the centre of track in straight. (Nose Roll FIRST TIME) # ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 600m was steadied when awkwardly placed inside heels. Was held up on heels for a short distance after entering the home straight. Shifted out under pressure down the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled touch Worse than midfield Two Wide 6 Lengths 600m, did not finish race off # never came on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Near the 800m was steadied outwards after improving onto heels. Inclined to hang out between the 600m and 400m.
